scope: Offline tunable split-K for explicit gfx1250 BF16/FP16 TDM GEMM
infrastructure: GemmCommonTuner selection/CSV merge; run_perftest CUDA-event timing of 8-call CUDA Graph replay
limitations: Two seeded random inputs per candidate; not arbitrary-data precision proof
Atomic opt-in has low-precision rounding and nondeterministic arrival order
FP32 workspace is fixed-order, not guaranteed bitwise equal to unsplit accumulation
Finite pruned search, not globally optimal configs; no serving-performance claim
GPU timing excludes CPU allocation/launch overhead; all GPU reduction work included
Some independent reload A/A measurements differ by several percent
Single writer per output CSV; --mp1 only
